svg.title: ImSwitch2 Architecture — Dependency Map
svg.desc: Shows the MVP layers: Views/Widgets at top, Controllers in middle, Managers at bottom, with hardware interfaces below. Arrows show dependencies.
svg.text: MVP pattern: View → Controller → Manager → Hardware Interface
CommunicationChannel — sigUpdateImage, sigRunScan, sigSnapImg, sigRecordingStarted, ... (30+ signals)
MasterController — instantiates all managers, passed as _master to every controller
MultiManager pattern — dynamic sub-manager loading by class name from JSON config
+ bundled: pipython (PI GCS2), pyicic (TIS), hamamatsu DCAM (ctypes), SmarACT MCS (ctypes), SQUID protocol
imcontrol_setups/*.json — full hardware config (SetupInfo dataclass tree)
1. EtSTEDInfo defined twice in SetupInfo.py (merge artifact)
4. Legacy SLMController/slmManager still in codebase (dead code)
